problems.reason: Both sentences give different ages for the same fossil (151 Ma vs. 150 Ma) without indicating they are different estimates.
Both sentences repeat the claim that the fossil dates to the Late Jurassic, providing the same information twice.

notes: - contradiction: "Dating back approximately 151 million years, this fossil is regarded as one of the most well-preserved dinosaur remains globally." / "Sciurumimus lived during the Kimmeridgian stage of the Late Jurassic, roughly 150 million years ago in what is now Europe.": Both sentences give different ages for the same fossil (151 Ma vs. 150 Ma) without indicating they are different estimates.
